body:
🦩 Flamingo Mod – Colorful Life Comes to Minecraft! \
The Flamingo Mod adds elegant and vibrant flamingos to the Minecraft world, adding a touch of color to the natural world. This mod offers players a tropical atmosphere with both decorative and interactive features.

🔹 Features: \
🌴 New Flamingo Entity: Pink flamingos roam natural wetlands. \
🎨 Decorative Flamingo Statues: Aesthetic blocks you can place in your garden or poolside. \
🪶 Feathers and Special Items: New armor or ornaments with special feathers that can be obtained from flamingos.

🛠️ Compatibility: \
Minecraft 1.20.1 and above \
Fabric, Forge \
FPS-friendly, runs smoothly even on low-end systems. https://www.youtube.com/@Casiriusmc for a detailed video.
